relevance_note: Registry cohort of SSADHD patients with several identifiable individuals, e.g. 'One patient (SSADH\_21) had a severe phenotype ... He had a known homozygous variant ... c.1226G>A'.
method_note: No supplementary material in the file; Table S1 and Table S2 (per-patient data) are not available, so only patients named by an SSADHD_xx label in the text or Table 1 get rows (13 labelled patients plus the older brother of SSADHD_21). The other cohort members (31 SSADHD patients in total) are described only at group level and get no rows. A Python script in the scratch directory assembled the JSON and computed Table 1 row-prefix spans; each value was read by hand and the script output checked against the table. Table 1 is a rotated table (patients as columns; Pat_ID row at the bottom; column headers are the Pat_ID cells SSADHD_10, SSADHD_14, SSADHD_19, 'SSADHD_20 SSADHD_21', SSADHD_22, SSADHD_25, (empty), SSADHD_28). Its conversion is garbled: the first ('(age) Specific treatment for movement disorder spectrum') and BrainMRI rows carry wrapped text across columns, so MRI was taken only where the cell text is coherent (SSADHD_10 'AV 10 years: Increased T2-weighted signal of GP'; SSADHD_14 'AV 8 and 11 years: ...'; SSADHD_28 'Normal'). The 'No' treatment cells were not used. SSADHD_20 and SSADHD_21 share one merged column: only 'Dystonia Dystonia' (identical for both) was used; their onset ('3.5 years N/A'), description, severity ('Mild ! resolved Moderate ! N/A') and MRI ('Normal AV 7 m: ...') were not assigned by position (D-31 spirit). The second Table 1 fragment (SSADHD_29, SSADHD_31) is converted into a single garbled header row; values were used only from text in the same cell as the Pat_ID (hypokinesia/dystonia/2.5 years/GP T2 for SSADHD_29; dyskinesia, athetoid movement and dentate T2 for SSADHD_31); SSADHD_31's onset '3 years 3 months' is split and was not recorded. The text writes 'SSADH\_21' once (Results 3.3); treated as SSADHD_21 (same context: diagnosed early because of an index sibling; older brother). The 'older brother' of SSADHD_21 is probably SSADHD_20 (the 'index patient (SSADHD_20) in the family') but the paper never says so explicitly, so the two were NOT merged; his zygosity is left 'not reported' ('same as his older brother' was not taken as a zygosity statement). SSADHD_28 'Normal' brain MRI recorded as 'abnormal brain MRI' excluded; the checklist MRI items stay not reported (D-27). Variant values are written with '>' although the Markdown encodes it as '>'; spans keep '>'. Transcript NM_001080.3 comes from the paper-wide Methods statement. Functional evidence for p.Gly409Asp comes from Table 2 (column 11, 'Experimental enzyme activity <1%') and the molecular-modeling sentence. cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is set true from '27 unpublished cases' out of 31; no citation for the earlier reports is given. Group counts (e.g. 'dystonia [n = 5]', 'three individuals who were homozygous for c.1226G>A' with no sleep problems or seizures) exclude no one and were not assigned to people. Contradictions: Results say 'Thirtyone patients ... from 27 families' but 3.5 says '26 different families'; Discussion says '12 missense variants' vs 13 in Results; Table 2 lists c.803G>A as p.Gly268Glu while the text writes 'c.803G>A, p.Gly208Glu'.
